enrichment-abilities.json.community_notes: [APPROX] Random D6 table (1-2 Sustained Hits 1, 3-4 Lethal Hits, 5-6 improve AP by 2 on a Critical Wound) flattened to a choice; the AP option's Critical Wound-only rider, the [HAZARDOUS] rider for deliberately selecting an option, and the two-source Hazardous fail-on-1-or-2 escalation are dropped. Full rule in raw-text store.
